column1: # Recovered cipher key for Modena, Biblioteca Estense Universitaria, Autografoteca Campori,
# Gonzaga Federico II, sfasc. II, cc. 13r-13v (Cyphersolver catalogue 2162, 6 May 1537).
# Architecture: directional i-digraph + homophonic substitution + two-digit/underlined-L nomenclator.
# Post-peer-review edition: disputed ig=g removed (L12 idtiigx=fussi, L18 li4ig4six=passati);
# open proper-noun nomenclators and candidate numeric nulls/function codes kept explicitly open.
